why: The floor under the tabbed component docs population. It may rise as a component gains a docs page, and never falls except by a hand edit that names the removal. Re-measure and raise it with `npm run check:docs-tabs -- --update`. Lowered from 80 to 71: Card, Divider, Collapse, Jumbotron, List group, Media object, Scrollspy, Nav pills and Navbar were retired and their docs pages deleted.
